Someone got past the first step of signing in to your LaunchSafe account (single sign-on), then entered too many wrong codes for your second step. They were not let in, and their codes aren’t checked again for a while.

If this wasn’t you, someone can use your single sign-on account: secure it now. Your second step kept them out, and LaunchSafe support can help.

You get this whenever a sign-in to your LaunchSafe account is stopped.
